title: Proxy Network / IPRoyal Bandwidth
description: Account-wide IPRoyal bandwidth view — all sub-users, plus entry-node benchmark latency from the startup/6h selection cycle. Complements Kioo Labs/bandwidth-per-subuser.json, which is scoped to a single sub-user.

panels.title: Account Traffic Available (GB)
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER METRIC — iproyal_account_traffic_available_gb, from GET /me (account-level), distinct from the per-subuser iproyal_subuser_traffic_available_gb already wired. Wire up alongside the existing IPRoyal API client work.

panels.title: Entry Node Benchmark Latency
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER METRIC — proxy_entry_node_latency_ms{node=...}, distinct from proxy_upstream_latency_ms (the currently-selected entry's live latency, already wired in Proxy Network/socks5-connections.json). This panel is the full benchmark set from GET /access/entry-nodes, refreshed on startup + every 6h.
